sourceOccurrences.note: The source is the initial real inequality 2ab <= a^2+b^2, with unrestricted real a and b. The variance proof explains it from (a-b)^2 >= 0 and records the corresponding two-point convexity identity. Variance tensorization and derivative bounds are expository results; they are not attributed to this one-theorem source.
